hunting_bow.name: Hunting Bow
hunting_bow.description: A simple recurve bow for ranged combat. Less powerful than war bows but accurate in skilled hands.

composite_war_bow.name: Composite War Bow
composite_war_bow.description: A layered horn-and-sinew bow capable of punching arrows through armour at range. Requires significant strength to draw.

jade_crossbow.name: Jade-Inlaid Crossbow
jade_crossbow.description: A precision repeating crossbow. Fires three bolts in quick succession. Associated with Jiangnan artisan sects.
